legacy_receipt_and.oracle_vector_definition: at each condition, the one or two required-effect predicate labels at the injection frame are reduced by legacy receipt AND; the expected vector repeats that receipt value for every required effect

task_success_gain_interval.lower_rule: concordant cells inherit stored M3 minus M0 task_success; every divergent faulted cell is assigned worst-case gain -1
task_success_gain_interval.neutral_rule: conditional descriptive assumption: every divergent faulted cell has zero gain
task_success_gain_interval.upper_rule: conditional descriptive assumption: every divergent unit inherits the stored pilot M3 minus M0 task_success
